package.name: odf-agent-team
package.description: ODF — spec-driven Odoo delivery on OpenCode

skills.name: oca-governance-pr-workflow
skills.title: OCA PR Workflow
skills.compact_rules:
- An issue must exist and be approved before branching.
- Branch: {fix|imp|add|ref|rem|mig}/{module}-{desc}, lowercase, no spaces.
- Commit in OCA format: [TAG] module_name: short description.
- PR body: Description, Related Issue (Closes #N), OCA Compliance Checklist.
- Alpha/Beta need 1 review; Stable 2 reviews + 5 days + tests; Mature adds docs and contributors.
- Never force-push after review starts; do not squash without asking.

changelog.change: Restructured to gentle-ai standard (Output Contract, Decision Gates, Hard Rules)

skills.name: oca-governance-commit-messages
skills.title: OCA Commit Messages
skills.compact_rules:
- Format: [TAG] module_name: short description, max 50 chars.
- Tags: FIX, ADD, IMP, REF, REM, MIG, MOV, DOC, TEST, SEC, PERF.
- Imperative mood: Fix, not Fixed; Add, not Added.
- Body explains WHY, wrapped at 80 chars; one logical change per commit.
- Multi-module: [IMP] mod1, mod2: description.
- No period in the subject, no past tense, no 'fix pep8' commits.

changelog.change: Added full OCA commit reference (12 tags, imperative mood, multi-module, squash rules)

skills.name: oca-contributing-guidelines
skills.title: OCA Contributing Guidelines
skills.compact_rules:
- Module names are singular; base_ prefix for base modules; l10n_CC_ for localizations.
- Manifest: license, images, OCA author, website https://github.com/OCA/<repo>.
- Import order: stdlib, third-party, odoo, local; no wildcard imports.
- Never interpolate SQL; use %s parameters or the ORM.
- Add tests for new behavior; version as <odoo>.<major>.<minor>.<patch>.
- Respect API stability: additions are allowed, breaking changes need a major bump.

changelog.change: Created from OCA contributing docs in obsidian vault

skills.name: oca-python-style
skills.title: OCA Python Style
skills.compact_rules:
- Import order: stdlib, third-party, odoo, odoo addons, relative local.
- Model body order: attributes, fields, SQL constraints, defaults, computes, constraints, CRUD, actions.
- Never concatenate SQL; use %s parameters, tuples for IN, and cr.savepoint() instead of cr.commit().
- Prefer the ORM; use sudo() narrowly and _() for user-facing strings.
- Methods take a recordset and iterate over self.
- Max line length 88; never use bare except clauses; name Many2one fields _id and x2many fields _ids.

skills.name: oca-xml-style
skills.title: OCA XML Style
skills.compact_rules:
- Indent using 4 spaces.
- Place id attribute before model.
- For field declarations, name attribute first, then value, then other attributes ordered by importance.
- Group records by model.
- Use <data> only for not-updatable data with noupdate=1.
- Use <odoo> for noupdate=0 or demo data.
- Use <odoo noupdate='1'> for noupdate data.
- Do not prefix the xmlid by the current module's name.
- Inherit views with xpath (expr + position); name views <model>_view_<type>.

skills.name: oca-manifest-format
skills.title: OCA Manifest Format
skills.compact_rules:
- Required keys: name, version, category, author, website, license, depends, data, installable.
- Version format: {odoo_version}.{major}.{minor}.{patch}, for example 18.0.1.0.0.
- license and images are mandatory; avoid empty keys.
- Author must include ', Odoo Community Association (OCA)'; website must point to the OCA repository.
- development_status must match the real maturity level.

skills.name: odoo-modeling
skills.title: Odoo Modeling
skills.compact_rules:
- Read the topic reference before writing model code.
- Prefer computed fields over onchange for persisted values; list every dependency.
- _inherit extends, _name + _inherit creates, _inherits delegates.
- Validate with constraints, never with UI onchange alone.
- Never interpolate SQL; use parameters or the ORM.
- Add a regression test for every behavior change.

skills.name: security-guide
skills.title: Odoo Security Guide
skills.compact_rules:
- Security is version-sensitive: load the target version's security guide before writing rules.
- Every model needs ir.model.access.csv entries per group; record rules filter rows.
- Check groups= on fields, menus, and actions; never expose sensitive fields to base users.
- Verify company rules (_check_company_auto, check_company=True) on multi-company models.
- Do not rely on this dispatcher; read the version-specific file.
- Use sudo() only with justification and check access rights before operations.

skills.name: odoo-views-owl
skills.title: Odoo Views and OWL
skills.compact_rules:
- Inherit views with xpath; never copy core views.
- v17+ uses invisible/readonly/required expressions; attrs is gone.
- Restrict fields, menus, and actions with groups.
- Window actions need res_model; wizards use target=new.
- Handle dialog cancel explicitly.
- Load the target version's OWL guide before writing components.

skills.name: odoo-testing
skills.title: Odoo Testing and Quality
skills.compact_rules:
- Run the real module suite; a skipped test is not a pass.
- Use TransactionCase, HttpCase, or Form for the behavior under test.
- Cover CRUD, computes, constraints, access rights, and failure paths.
- Run OCA compliance checks before opening a PR.
- Measure performance before optimizing.
- Diagnose errors against the target Odoo version.

skills.name: odoo-versioning
skills.title: Odoo Versioning
skills.compact_rules:
- Determine the target Odoo version first; never assume.
- 16-19 are supported; 15 is migration source only.
- Load the version-specific file before writing or upgrading code.
- Never copy a pattern across versions without checking the target API.
- Community modules must not depend on Enterprise modules.
- Verify XML IDs and model names against the target source.

skills.name: odf-assess
skills.title: Assess Odoo Requirement
skills.compact_rules:
- Standard Odoo first: check settings, automated actions, and Studio before custom code.
- Produce only specifications or configuration guides, never code.
- Confirm the target Odoo version before analysis.
- Formal mode numbers requirements REQ-01; lean mode returns a bounded decision with no REQ catalog.
- Every requirement needs an acceptance criterion and a testable scenario.

changelog.change: Restructured: 249→50 lines, Output Contract, Decision Gates for standard vs custom

skills.name: odf-design
skills.title: Design Odoo Module
skills.compact_rules:
- Read the real Odoo source being extended before designing.
- Read the expectations artifact and resolve every EXP-XX; a missing row means the design is not closed.
- No Python or XML in the design; use the contract tables for fields, views, and tasks.
- design_closed must be true before IMPLEMENT.
- Flag contradictions with source or expectations instead of deciding silently.

changelog.change: Clarify closed-design applicability by persisted route
Added layered phase boundaries, precision invariants, source authority, product-ambiguity blocking, and explicit frontend handoffs
Activation contract and closed-design blocking aligned with IMPLEMENT
Closed design document contract (docs/design-contract.md); resolve human EXP-XX; fix target module; IMPLEMENT must not re-investigate

skills.name: odf-implement
skills.title: Implement Odoo Tasks
skills.compact_rules:
- Require the persisted route inputs: work_type, plan mode, approved Expectations, exact scope.
- plan: required needs approved ASSESS and DESIGN with design_closed true; plan: inline needs its approved tasks and QA.
- Follow approved decisions; report deviations and stop for disposition, never expand scope silently.
- Tests land in the same commit as the behavior; mark [x] only after verified behavior.
- Run pre-commit and pylint-odoo per batch; write validation evidence last.

changelog.change: Finalize candidate artifacts before evidence and clarify IMPLEMENT digest semantics
Make IMPLEMENT compact rules route-aware for inline-plan BUILD
Allow current-run user-authorized non-isolated development databases while preserving destructive-operation gates
Block and reopen DESIGN when design_closed is not true
Restructured: 266→53 lines, smoke tests per batch

skills.name: odf-batch-implement
skills.title: Bounded Odoo Batch Implementation
skills.compact_rules:
- Require the persisted route inputs before editing; never infer the route from absent artifacts.
- Batch 1 may initialize progress; continuation batches merge into existing progress, never overwrite.
- Keep each batch inside the approved scope and record deviations.
- Tests and docs land with the behavior in the same batch.
- Close only with verified evidence; otherwise report blocked.

changelog.change: Settle progress before validation evidence and clarify route-specific candidate digests
Allow route-approved inline-plan BUILD without formal PLAN artifacts

skills.name: odf-verify
skills.title: Verify Odoo Implementation
skills.compact_rules:
- Classify the risk tier from the frozen diff before any verification work.
- Run the real module test suite; static analysis and manual checks are not substitutes.
- Every EXP-XX and REQ-XX needs a passing test; an untested item is CRITICAL.
- HIGH runs 4 lenses, MEDIUM 1, LOW structural readback only.
- Never fix issues; report them with evidence and a verdict: PASS, PASS WITH WARNINGS, FAIL, or BLOCKED.

changelog.change: Manual test execution: user-run evidence via odf-toolkit manual-evidence (executor user-manual) is valid VERIFY evidence
Allow current-run user-authorized non-isolated development databases with explicit mutation warnings
Activation contract and approved EXP-XX verification wording aligned
Restructured + Judgment Day adversarial review (3-pass: reviewer, maintainer, attacker)

skills.name: skill-resolver
skills.title: Skill Resolver Protocol
skills.compact_rules:
- Resolve skills once per session and cache the index: name, trigger, path.
- Read odf-registry.json first; fall back to Engram, then the filesystem.
- Inject at most 5 matching skills per delegation; prefer project-specific over global.
- Pass skills by identifier or workspace-relative path, never absolute paths.
- If no registry exists, warn and proceed without project standards.
- The canonical stage skill also contributes its full SKILL.md body; bundled references are listed, not inlined.

changelog.change: Aligned skill folder/name and removed universal stock assertions

skills.name: odf-agent-builder
skills.title: ODF Agent Builder
skills.compact_rules:
- Check the registry and Engram for duplicates before generating; ask before overwriting.
- Generate SKILL.md and AGENT.md with all required sections and validate them.
- Register in both odf-registry.json and Engram.
- NotebookLM enrichment is optional; flag when unavailable.
- Never publish an agent without user preview and approval.

changelog.change: Clarified no human approvals while retaining mechanical safety gates
Restructured: 222→60 lines, added frontmatter + Decision Gates

skills.name: odf-fix
skills.title: ODF Bugfix Flow
skills.compact_rules:
- No stage-approval pauses, but policy gates, evidence, and VERIFY still apply.
- Identify the root cause before modifying any code.
- Add a test that fails without the fix and passes with it.
- Keep the change minimal and inside the reported bug.
- Escalate to /odf-new when the fix changes scope or needs design.

changelog.change: Added activation contract and local-source verification boundary
Restructured: Activation Contract → Hard Rules → Decision Gates → Execution Steps → Output Contract

skills.name: odf-explore
skills.title: ODF Codebase Exploration
skills.compact_rules:
- Search the local Odoo source for the target version before concluding.
- Read the actual models, views, and tests; never guess behavior.
- Check whether standard Odoo already covers the need.
- Cite file:line for every claim; recollection is not evidence.
- Stay read-only: report findings, do not modify code.

changelog.change: QA starts from approved EXP-XX and chooses test class by behavior
Restructured: 235→43 lines, Output Contract, fff/fff_grep instructions

skills.name: odf-init
skills.title: ODF Project Init
skills.compact_rules:
- Detect before asking; try every detection method first.
- Never guess: set unknown fields to null instead of inventing values.
- Persist partial detection; partial is better than none.
- Re-running /odf-init upserts the existing config.
- glossary and principles contain only detected or user-confirmed entries.

changelog.change: Project-scoped, cwd-independent Engram readback with artifact_ref; git-remote project identity documented

Allow current-run user-authorized non-isolated development databases while preserving destructive-operation gates
Restructured: 274→50 lines, decision gates for detection

skills.name: odf-qa
skills.title: ODF QA Workflow
skills.compact_rules:
- Map every approved EXP-XX to a focused check before writing tests.
- Choose the narrowest valid class: TransactionCase, SavepointCase, HttpCase, or JS test.
- Run real coverage tools; never estimate percentages.
- Formal QA-PLAN only when the route or risk escalation requires it.
- Untested critical paths block the acceptance verdict.

skills.name: oca-work-unit-commits
skills.title: OCA Work Unit Commits
skills.compact_rules:
- OCA format: [TAG] module_name: short description, max 50 chars.
- Tags: FIX, ADD, IMP, REF, REM, MIG, MOV, DOC, TEST, SEC, PERF.
- Imperative mood; body explains why, wrapped at 80 chars.
- One deliverable behavior per commit; tests and docs go with it.
- Do not split a behavior into code, test, and docs commits.

changelog.change: Missing red evidence now blocks strict TDD
Created from gentle-ai pattern: work-unit commits with OCA format

skills.name: oca-cognitive-doc-design
skills.title: OCA Cognitive Doc Design
skills.compact_rules:
- Lead with the answer — Put the decision, action, or outcome first. Context comes after.
- Progressive disclosure — Happy path first, then details, edge cases, references.
- Chunking — Group related info into small sections. Keep lists short.
- Signposting — Use headings, labels, callouts, and summaries so readers know where they are.
- Recognition over recall — Tables, checklists, examples > prose that must be remembered.
- Review empathy — Design so reviewers verify intent without reconstructing the whole story.

changelog.change: Created from gentle-ai pattern: docs with low cognitive load

skills.name: oca-comment-writer
skills.title: OCA Comment Writer
skills.compact_rules:
- Be useful fast — Start with the actionable point. Do not recap the whole PR before feedback.
- Be warm and direct — Sound like a thoughtful teammate, not a corporate bot.
- Keep it short — 1-3 short paragraphs or a tight bullet list.
- Explain why — Give the technical reason when asking for a change.
- Avoid pile-ons — Comment on the highest-value issue, not every tiny preference.

changelog.change: Created from gentle-ai pattern: warm, direct collaboration comments

skills.name: odf-propose
skills.title: ODF Business Proposal
skills.compact_rules:
- No code; produce only the proposal document, under 300 words.
- Consume the orchestrator's resolved decisions; never re-interview the user.
- Fill the capabilities section; it is the contract with ASSESS.
- Every proposal needs measurable success criteria and a rollback plan.
- Stay inside the requested scope; flag open product decisions instead of assuming.

changelog.change: Initial propose phase: question round + lightweight proposal before ASSESS
Standardized ODF Result status semantics and shared References

skills.name: odf-tdd
skills.title: ODF Strict TDD
skills.compact_rules:
- Resolve the effective mode before each IMPLEMENT or VERIFY: global AND local, any off wins, unreadable local means OFF.
- Write the failing test first and persist a real non-zero red run.
- Pair every REQ-XX with a test task.
- Keep tests with the code in the same commit.
- VERIFY rejects code without matching tests when the mode is ON.

skills.name: oca-chained-pr
skills.title: OCA Chained PRs
skills.compact_rules:
- Split PRs over 400 lines — Unless a maintainer accepts size:exception.
- Budget is not code-golf — Never shrink a diff by deleting comments, blank lines, docs, or tests, or by compressing code, to fit the review budget. Slice by work unit or report the overage.
- One slicing pass — If no cohesive split fits after one honest pass, stop; keep the best split and recommend size:exception.
- ≤60 min review per PR — Each PR must be reviewable in about 60 minutes.
- Tests+docs stay with unit — Tests and docs belong with the work unit they verify.

changelog.change: Initial chained PR skill from gentle-ai pattern

skills.name: odf-oca-governance
skills.title: OCA AI Governance
skills.compact_rules:
- Load policies/oca-ai-policy.md and policies/oca/rules.yaml before acting.
- Record AI provenance with the governance provenance tool when AI assisted.
- Run odf_governance_check before commit, review publication, or PR.
- Keep Assisted-by: separate from Co-authored-by: and disclose AI use.
- Never auto-commit or auto-publish; this gate does not replace VERIFY.

changelog.change: Initial OCA AI governance profile with provenance and human-acknowledgement checks

skills.name: karpathy-precision
skills.title: Karpathy Precision
skills.compact_rules:
- State assumptions explicitly before implementing. If uncertain, ask.
- If multiple interpretations exist, present all — do NOT pick silently.
- No features beyond what was asked. No abstractions for single-use code.
- No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
- Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
- Don't refactor things that aren't broken. Match existing style.
- Every changed line must trace directly to the task requirement.
- Transform imperative tasks into verifiable goals with verification per step.
- If 200 lines could be 50, rewrite it smaller.

skills.name: oca-maintainer-role
skills.title: Oca Maintainer Role
skills.compact_rules:
- Maintainers triage issues, review PRs, and keep modules compatible with supported versions.
- Respond to new issues within a week; acknowledge PRs even when review is delayed.
- Use labels to categorize and keep the PR queue moving.
- The PSC coordinates cross-repo policy and can remove inactive maintainers.
- Becoming a maintainer requires sustained contributions and nomination; declare it in the README.

skills.name: oca-maturity-levels
skills.title: Oca Maturity Levels
skills.compact_rules:
- Alpha: CI green, 1 review, formatted, installs; tests optional; development only.
- Beta: same as Alpha; pre-production, not for production use.
- Stable: 2 reviews + 5-day period, tests required, depends only on Stable/Mature.
- Mature: exists in the previous version, good coverage, no lint beta warnings, USAGE.rst, 2+ contributors, 1+ maintainer, OpenUpgrade scripts.
- Declare the real level in development_status.

skills.name: oca-repository-policy
skills.title: Oca Repository Policy
skills.compact_rules:
- Modules must pass CI: flake8/ESLint, compilation, tests, documentation.
- API stability: additions are allowed; renames, signature changes, removals, and default changes are breaking.
- Breaking changes require a major version bump, a migration script, and documentation.
- Keep repositories focused on one business domain; do not add unrelated modules.
- Branch per Odoo version; dependencies must be Stable or Mature.

skills.name: common-module-templates
skills.title: Common Module Templates
skills.compact_rules:
- Pick the template by target app: sale, stock, hr, crm, account, website, or project.
- Templates target v18; adapt the manifest version and APIs to the real target version.
- Keep the OCA layout: models/, views/, security/, data/.
- Copy only the sections the change needs; do not ship unused template files.
- Run pre-commit and module tests after adapting a template.

skills.name: oca-naming-conv
skills.title: Oca Naming Conv
skills.compact_rules:
- Module names are singular: sale_order, not sale_orders; base_ prefix for base modules; l10n_CC_ for localizations.
- Extending an Odoo module: prefix with that module, for example mail_forward or sale_stock_custom.
- Files: models/<model>.py, views/<model>_views.xml, security/ir.model.access.csv.
- XML IDs: <model>_view_<type>, <model>_action, menu_<model>.
- Never prefix xmlids with the current module name.

skills.name: odoo-module-generator
skills.title: Odoo Module Generator
skills.compact_rules:
- Determine the target version before generating and load its version-specific file.
- Emit the full skeleton: manifest, __init__, models/, views/, security/, data/.
- Manifest: name, version <odoo>.1.0.0, license AGPL-3, OCA author, depends, data, installable.
- Verify external XML IDs and models against the local source; never invent them.
- Return structured output: files, dependencies, warnings, version.

skills.name: odoo-business-flows
skills.title: Odoo Business Flows
skills.compact_rules:
- Identify the business domain, then read its reference before coding.
- Filter by company and respect record rules on every business model.
- Prefer the ORM over SQL; never hardcode taxes, accounts, or currencies.
- Use Monetary and Decimal for money, never float arithmetic.
- Add tests for the workflow and its failure paths.
- Load the target-version behavior before copying a pattern.

skills.name: oca-code-review
skills.title: Oca Code Review
skills.compact_rules:
- Review order: compliance check, pattern match, improvement suggestions, compiled report.
- Report critical and high issues separately with file, line, issue, and fix.
- Classify findings by severity; never merge standards and spec findings.
- State a verdict: ready, needs work, or cannot merge, with evidence.
- Never fix during review; return findings to the orchestrator.

skills.name: oca
skills.title: OCA Skills Index
skills.compact_rules:
- Use this catalog to locate a standalone skill or a domain reference.
- Categories: ODF stages, OCA governance/style, five Odoo domain routers, shared conventions, tools.
- Prefer the specific skill or domain router over this catalog for actual work.
- Version guides 16-19 are supported; 15 is migration source only.
- The registry is authoritative; this catalog is a navigation aid.

skills.name: oca-api-lookup
skills.title: Oca Api Lookup
skills.compact_rules:
- Search the local Odoo source or codegraph before answering; do not rely on memory.
- Prefer ORM decorators: @api.depends for computed, @api.constrains for validation, @api.onchange for UI.
- Use @api.model_create_multi for batch create; @api.model when no recordset is needed.
- Show a real example from the target version with file:line.
- Flag version differences; APIs change between 16 and 19.

skills.name: oca-documentation-gen
skills.title: Oca Documentation Gen
skills.compact_rules:
- Generate README.md, DESCRIPTION.rst, USAGE.rst, CONTRIBUTORS.rst, and HISTORY.rst.
- README: overview, features, installation, configuration, usage, credits, license.
- Keep USAGE.rst task-oriented; HISTORY.rst follows the OCA changelog format.
- Do not invent screenshots or badges; reference real files.
- Match the manifest license and author.

skills.name: oca-lookup-guideline
skills.title: Oca Lookup Guideline
skills.compact_rules:
- Use the OCA rules already captured in this pack; do not depend on an external vault path.
- Commit tags: FIX, ADD, IMP, REF, REM, MIG, MOV, DOC, TEST, SEC, PERF.
- Format: [TAG] module_name: short description, imperative mood, max 50 chars.
- PRs need a related issue and the OCA checklist.
- If a rule is missing, check the governance skill before inventing one.

skills.name: oca-migration-assist
skills.title: Oca Migration Assist
skills.compact_rules:
- Priority: OpenUpgrade upgrade_analysis.txt, then Odoo changelogs, then OCA migration PRs.
- Read the analysis for the module before writing migration scripts.
- Scripts go in migrations/<version>/pre|post-*.py; make them idempotent and batched.
- Document renamed or removed fields and irreversible steps.
- Test on real data; verify counts and constraints after migration.

skills.name: oca-migration-status
skills.title: Oca Migration Status
skills.compact_rules:
- Classify each module: MIGRATED (exists in target branch), IN_PR (open [MIG] PR), MISSING (no PR).
- List modules from the source branch, then compare with the target branch.
- Search PRs by [MIG] title and module name.
- Report counts and percentages; include PR links for IN_PR.
- Re-check before reporting; PR state changes.

skills.name: oca-odoo-local-search
skills.title: Oca Odoo Local Search
skills.compact_rules:
- Search the local Odoo source first; use rg for text and find for paths.
- Read the actual model, view, and test files; never guess framework behavior.
- Cite file:line for every claim.
- Restrict searches to the target version's source tree.
- If the source is absent, say so instead of inventing behavior.

skills.name: oca-pattern-match
skills.title: Oca Pattern Match
skills.compact_rules:
- Search odoo/odoo for official patterns and OCA/* for community conventions.
- Prefer local source or codegraph over remote search when available.
- Match the target version; do not copy patterns from another version.
- Report file:line and the purpose of each pattern.
- Flag patterns that conflict with OCA style.

skills.name: oca-pr-checkout
skills.title: Oca Pr Checkout
skills.compact_rules:
- Get PR metadata first: head branch, author, state, mergeable, files.
- In an existing clone: gh pr checkout <number>.
- Manual: git fetch origin pull/<number>/head:pr-<number> and git checkout pr-<number>.
- Checkout dependency PRs first, in order, then the main PR.
- Warn that PR code is not approved for production.
- Never push to a PR branch unless the author asks.

skills.name: oca-pr-dependencies
skills.title: Oca Pr Dependencies
skills.compact_rules:
- Read the PR body for 'Depends on:' and 'And indirectly on:' links.
- Parse OCA/{repo}#{number} and github.com/OCA/{repo}/pull/{number}.
- Verify each dependency state before checkout.
- Build the tree in order; checkout dependencies first.
- Report missing or closed dependencies as blockers.

skills.name: oca-search-migration-prs
skills.title: Oca Search Migration Prs
skills.compact_rules:
- Search PRs by [MIG] plus the module name in the target OCA repo.
- Parse titles: [MIG] module: ..., [X.0][MIG] module, and escaped variants.
- Use gh pr list with state filters; include closed PRs to detect abandoned work.
- Report PR number, state, author, and module.
- Handle no-results explicitly; never conclude 'missing' from one query.

skills.name: oca-suggest-improve
skills.title: Oca Suggest Improve
skills.compact_rules:
- Check security first: SQL injection, XSS, permissions, sudo misuse.
- Then performance: N+1 queries, missing indexes, Python loops over recordsets.
- Then code quality: duplication, long methods, naming, dead code.
- Then Odoo conventions: ORM over SQL, translations, manifest, tests.
- Rank by severity and give a concrete fix per finding.

skills.name: oca-upgrade-analysis
skills.title: Oca Upgrade Analysis
skills.compact_rules:
- Read OpenUpgrade upgrade_analysis.txt for the module and target version first.
- Then Odoo changelogs, then OCA migration PRs.
- Report renamed, removed, and changed fields and methods.
- Rank findings by migration risk.
- Never invent an analysis entry; cite the file.
